carbon_policy_signal.item: Ireland backs EU carbon-border-adjustment mechanism (CBAM) and e-waste levy; signals cost floor for non-compliant imports.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: CBAM cost floor supports EUA baseline and power-generation competitiveness vs. extra-EU; accelerates fuel-switch economics and carbon-intensive plant retirement, raising merit-order carbon shadow cost.

base.summary: GB/DE power elevated on storage deficit and geopolitical crude premium; renewables volatility contained.

downside.summary: Trump announces Iran deal imminent; geopolitical premium unwinds. US LNG supply eases TTF.

upside.summary: US-Iran escalation broadens to Hormuz chokepoint; Iranian oil/LNG facilities hit; crude spikes.

top_takeaway: GB Power at 99th percentile (189.35 EUR/MWh) amid renewable spike (+753%, 25σ); TTF +2.3σ and +30% monthly on geopolitical crude risk offsetting US LNG supply surge.

watchlist.metric: GB Power premium to DE (189.35 vs 172.77 EUR/MWh)
watchlist.why: 16.6 EUR/MWh gap at 99th percentile; reflects GB supply tightness and isolation. Monitor BSP/interconnector flows; gap could compress if LNG arbitrage strengthens or renewables sustain.
Extreme statistical outlier (25.0σ); if wind/solar reverses sharply, thermal dispatch call rises and power curve reprices upward. Track DAM clearing prices and reserve adequacy alerts.

watchlist.metric: TTF vs. Brent arbitrage (TTF +30% monthly; crude supply risk)
watchlist.why: US-Iran tanker strikes tightening crude; competing LNG supply easing from US capacity. Brent floor and LNG charter costs will determine EU import cost. Watch daily LNG arrival schedules.

watchlist.metric: EU Storage refill pace (67.33%, 16.3 pp below seasonal)
watchlist.why: Injection pace must accelerate H2 to avoid Q4 heating crunch. Any supply interruption (sanctions, outages, geopolitical escalation) risks rapid tightening and power curve repricing.
